name: Inquisitor Fanged Inquisitor
body:
Fanged inquisitors deal with dissenters of the faith with subtlety and stealth, rather than loud pronouncements of judgment. Indeed, they file their teeth into sharp points, preferring to bite their enemies in rapid succession, rather than rely on manmade weaponry.

A fanged inquisitor has the following class features.

Special

A fanged inquisitor must worship a deity that offers the Animal domain or has hunting, nature, snakes, stealth, or wildlife as an area of concern.

Class Skills

A fanged inquisitor adds Escape Artist to her list of class skills and removes Ride.

This alters class skills.

Fanged (Ex)

At 1st level, a fanged inquisitor gains a natural bite attack. This is a primary attack, unless this attack is used in conjunction with weapon attacks, in which case, it is considered a secondary attack instead. A Medium fanged inquisitor deals 1d6 damage and applies her full Strength bonus on damage rolls with her bite attack. This damage increases using the same schedule as the unchained monk’s unarmed damage. This attack is not treated as a manufactured weapon, and therefore cannot benefit from spells or abilities that grant enhancements or bonuses to manufactured weapons.

Beginning at 3rd level, a fanged inquisitor’s deity bestows various blessings upon the bite attack, causing it to be treated as having certain qualities for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction. At 3rd level, the bite attack is treated as magic, at 8th level, it is treated as good, evil, chaotic, or lawful (the selection must match one of the fanged inquisitor’s alignment axises), at 14th level, it is treated as adamantine, and at 17th level, it is treated as poisonous.

Fanged inquisitor venom: Injury; save Fort DC 10 + 1/2 the fanged inquisitor’s level + the fanged inquisitor’s Wisdom modifier; frequency 1 round; effect 1d2 Dex damage; cure 1 save.

This replaces domain, exploit weakness, and slayer.

Flurry of Fangs (Ex)

At 1st level, a fanged inquisitor can make a flurry of fangs as a full-attack action as long as she does not use any manufactured weapons during the attack. When making a flurry of fangs, a fanged inquisitor forgoes all manufactured weapon attacks, attacking only with her natural bite attack.

She then makes one additional bite attack at her highest base attack bonus. This additional bite attack stacks with the bonus attacks from haste and other similar effects.

When using this ability, a fanged inquisitor does not gain any additional attacks for having a high base attack bonus.

For example, a 1st level fanged inquisitor with a +1 Strength modifier using flurry of fangs would make two bite attacks at +1 to hit (+0 BAB plus +1 Str modifier). This same inquisitor at 8th level would still get just the two attacks, but at +7 to hit (+6 BAB plus +1 Str modifier).

At 11th level, a fanged inquisitor can make an additional attack at her highest base attack bonus whenever she makes a flurry of fangs.

This stacks with the first attack from this ability and additional attacks from haste and similar effects. Thus, at 11th level, the same inquisitor mentioned above would make three bite attacks at +9 to hit (+8 BAB plus +1 Str modifier), while at 15th level, she would still make three attacks, but at +12 to hit (+11 BAB plus +1 Str modifier). A fanged inquisitor cannot make a flurry of fangs while in heavy armor or while carrying a heavy load.

This replaces judgement, second judgment, and third judgment.

Elusive Moves (Ex)

At 1st level, a fanged inquisitor gains a bonus equal to 1/2 her fanged inquisitor level on Escape Artist and Stealth skill checks.

This replaces stern gaze.

Inured to Venom (Ex)

At 3rd level, a fanged inquisitor gains a +2 sacred bonus on saving throws against poison. At 9th level, she gains immunity to poison.

This replaces solo tactics.

Ophidian Characteristics (Ex)

At 3rd level, and every three levels thereafter, a fanged inquisitor chooses one of the characteristics listed below. A characteristic can be chosen multiple times.

Each characteristic grants a selection of options. If the characteristic is chosen more than once, a different option must be selected each time the characteristic is chosen.

Disconcerting Rattler: As a swift action, a fanged inquisitor can emit an eerily menacing rattling sound with a 10 foot radius. All enemies within the radius must succeed on a Will save (DC = 10 + 1/2 the fanged inquisitor’s level + the fanged inquisitor’s Wisdom modifier) or become shaken for 1d4+1 rounds. Once a creature has been affected by this ability, it cannot be affected again for 24 hours. This is a mind-affecting fear effect. Each additional time this ability is chosen, the radius increases by +5 feet.

Ophidian Magic: Each time this ability is selected, a fanged inquisitor can choose one spell (of a level she is currently capable of casting) from this list. She can cast the spell as a spell-like ability (with a caster level equal to her inquisitor level) once per day. 1st level—nauseating dart, 2nd level—acute senses, 3rd level—summon nature’s ally III (viper, venomous snake, and constructor snake only), 4th level—spit venom, 5th level—fire snake, 6th level—beast shape IV.

A fanged inquisitor can use each of her selected spell-like abilities one additional time per day for every five fanged inquisitor levels she possesses beyond 10th level.

Scaly Skin: Each time this ability is chosen, a fanged inquisitor gains a +1 bonus to her natural armor class (to a maximum of +3).

Serpent Senses: Each time this ability is selected, a fanged inquisitor can choose one of the following: low-light vision or the special monster ability scent.

Slither: Each time this ability is selected, a fanged inquisitor can choose one of the following: climb speed 20 feet, swim speed 20 feet, rogue crawl rogue talent, or +4 enhancement bonus on CMD checks to avoid being grappled or tripped.

Swift Striker: Each time this ability is selected, a fanged inquisitor can choose one of the following bonus feats: Dodge, Improved Initiative, Mobility, or Spring Attack. The inquisitor must have all the required prerequisites to select one of these feats.

This replaces all teamwork feats.

Snake Soul (Ex)

At 20th level, a fanged inquisitor is a flurry of movement, bobbing and weaving as she rips into her foes. She cannot be tripped and treats her base attack bonus as equal to her fanged inquisitor level when making a flurry of fangs.

Additionally, whenever the inquisitor is exposed to a dose of poison, her adrenaline ramps up, granting her a +4 circumstance bonus to Strength and Dexterity for 1 round.

This replaces true judgment.
